column3: \t\t何戦かしてボロボロのランス・・
column4: After several battles, Rance is battered and worn out...

column3: \t\tその前に魔人レイが現れる
\t\tおっと、にがさねえぜ、俺と戦え
column4: Hey, you're not getting away. Fight me!

column3: \t\t・・・くそっ、とカオスを握りしめ突っ込む
column4: ...Damn it, gripping Chaos tightly, he charges in.

column3: \t\tそのまま死亡していくイメージ
column4: The image is that he dies just like that.
